name: chronotools
title: ChronoTools MCP Server
description: Model Context Protocol server for ChronoTools. Exposes world time conversion, stock market trading hours, ISO 8601 week numbers, and Unix epoch utilities to AI agents.

tools.name: convert_time
tools.description: Convert a specific timestamp or ISO date string between any two IANA timezones with Daylight Saving Time calculation.

sourceTimezone.description: Source IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York, UTC, Asia/Kolkata)

tools.name: get_market_hours
tools.description: Get current trading status and open/close countdown for major stock exchanges (NYSE, NASDAQ, LSE, TSE, HKEX, NSE).

tools.name: get_iso_week
tools.description: Calculate ISO 8601 week number, start date, and end date for any calendar year or date.

startDay.description: First day of the week convention

tools.name: convert_unix_epoch
tools.description: Convert between Unix timestamps (seconds or milliseconds) and formatted UTC/local date strings.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds
